```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)

contrast <- params$contrast
group    <- params$group

# Table row cap, defined here because it is referenced by prose above the
# chunk that used to define it (DE tables section).
DE_TABLE_CAP <- 500

# Write every static panel as both PNG (slides) and PDF (print/vector) under
# plots/. A missing device/library never fails the render.
save_fig <- function(name, plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150) {
  dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
  tryCatch(ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("plots", paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
                           width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi),
           error = function(e) NULL)
  tryCatch(ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("plots", paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                           width = width, height = height),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

ORIGIN_COLORS <- c(
  "novel"                = "#c2185b",
  "annotated_lncrna"     = "#2e7d32",
  "reference_other"      = "#7f7f7f"
)

ORIGIN_LABELS <- c(
  "novel"                = "Novel lncRNAs",
  "annotated_lncrna"     = "Annotated lncRNAs (reference)",
  "reference_other"      = "Other reference genes (background)"
)

# gffcompare class codes (source: gffcompare manual). `x` is opposite-strand
# exonic overlap; `s` is opposite-strand intronic and `i` can be either strand,
# so a class code alone does not prove sense/antisense.
CLASS_CODE_LEGEND <- c(
  "c" = "Contained in a reference transcript",
  "k" = "Contains a reference transcript",
  "m" = "Retained introns, all matching",
  "n" = "Retained introns, not all matching",
  "j" = "At least one junction shared with the reference",
  "e" = "Single exon overlapping an exon and >=10 bp of an intron (pre-mRNA fragment)",
  "o" = "Other same-strand exonic overlap",
  "s" = "Intron matching on the opposite strand (probable mapping error)",
  "x" = "Exonic overlap on the opposite strand (antisense)",
  "i" = "Entirely within an intron (strand not implied; same-strand can be pre-mRNA)",
  "y" = "Contains a reference transcript within its introns",
  "p" = "Possible polymerase run-on",
  "r" = "Repeat",
  "u" = "Intergenic (lincRNA-like)"
)

format_class_code <- function(cc) {
  if (is.na(cc) || cc == "") return(NA_character_)
  parts <- strsplit(cc, ",\\s*")[[1]]
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  desc <- CLASS_CODE_LEGEND[parts]
  desc[is.na(desc)] <- parts[is.na(desc)]
  paste0(sprintf("%s (%s)", parts, desc), collapse = "; ")
}

# Vectorised class-code label; NA (not "unknown") when no code applies.
fmt_class_label <- function(cc) {
  if (is.null(cc)) return(character(0))
  vapply(as.character(cc), format_class_code, character(1))
}

# Truncate long gene-list columns with click-to-expand via <details>
compact_gene_col <- function(x, max_show = 5) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || nchar(s) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    sep <- if (grepl("/", s, fixed = TRUE)) "/" else ",\\s*"
    genes <- strsplit(s, sep, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
    genes <- trimws(genes)
    genes <- genes[nzchar(genes)]
    n <- length(genes)
    if (n == 0) return("")
    shown <- paste(genes[seq_len(min(n, max_show))], collapse = ", ")
    full  <- paste(genes, collapse = ", ")
    if (n > max_show) {
      sprintf('<details><summary>%s <em>(+%d more)</em></summary>%s</details>',
              htmltools::htmlEscape(shown), n - max_show, htmltools::htmlEscape(full))
    } else {
      htmltools::htmlEscape(full)
    }
  }, character(1))
}

compact_list_columns <- function(tab) {
  for (nm in names(tab)) {
    x <- tab[[nm]]
    if (!is.character(x)) next
    if (any(nchar(x[!is.na(x)]) > 40)) {
      tab[[nm]] <- compact_gene_col(x)
    } else {
      tab[[nm]] <- htmltools::htmlEscape(x)
    }
  }
  tab
}

# Round numeric columns before rendering tables. p-value/adj columns keep
# 3 significant digits (notation) instead of a fixed round so tiny values
# survive; everything else gets a fixed number of decimals.
round_numeric_cols <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  p_cols <- grep("pvalue|padj|p\\.adjust|p_adjust|p\\.value|p_value|qvalue",
                 names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  for (nm in names(df)) {
    if (!is.numeric(df[[nm]])) next
    df[[nm]] <- if (nm %in% p_cols) signif(df[[nm]], 3) else round(df[[nm]], digits)
  }
  df
}

# Render an htmlwidget to raw HTML for use inside <details>. Registering the
# dependencies keeps the table interactive even when it is the only widget on
# the page (e.g. a contrast with zero significant genes).
render_widget_html <- function(w) {
  deps <- tryCatch(htmltools::htmlDependencies(w), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (length(deps) > 0) {
    tryCatch(knitr::knit_meta_add(deps), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  htmltools::doRenderTags(htmltools::tagList(w))
}
```

## Contrast: `r contrast`

```{r load, include=FALSE}
de <- tryCatch(
  read_tsv(params$de_summary, show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
de_ct <- if (!is.null(de) && "contrast" %in% colnames(de)) {
  filter(de, contrast == !!contrast)
} else { de }

catalog <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$gene_catalog, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 50000),
                    error = function(e) NULL)

de_ann <- de_ct
if (!is.null(catalog) && nrow(catalog) > 0 && "gene_id" %in% colnames(de_ct)) {
  de_ann <- de_ct %>%
    left_join(select(catalog, any_of(c("gene_id", "gene_name", "gene_biotype", "origin", "class_code",
                                       "catalog_id", "locus", "ref_gene_name", "known_catalog_hit",
                                       "catalog_sources", "novelty_class", "n_tx_hit", "n_tx",
                                       "in_lncipedia", "lncipedia_best_id", "lncipedia_best_pct",
                                       "in_noncode", "noncode_best_id", "noncode_best_pct",
                                       "in_rnacentral", "rnacentral_best_id", "rnacentral_best_pct",
                                       "in_fantomcat", "fantomcat_best_id", "fantomcat_best_pct",
                                       "chromosome", "start", "end", "strand",
                                       "conservation_mean", "conservation_pct", "syntenic_locus",
                                       "syntenic_target_gene_id", "lnc_position_class",
                                       "tier", "tier_final", "single_exon_low_confidence",
                                       "antisense_status", "x_host_leak_suspect",
                                       "gene_group", "ref_gene_relation"))),
              by = "gene_id")
}

# 4a.3/4b.1/4b.4: the report's own view of significance and grouping. The DE
# summary it reads does not carry the deliverable's flags, so they are recomputed
# here from the same thresholds. "significant" means `significant_padj`
# (padj < FDR); `significant_padj_lfc1` adds the |log2FC| >= LFC cutoff and is used
# only where a section or tab names it explicitly.
ORIGIN_TO_GROUP <- c(
  "novel"            = "novel_lncRNA",
  "annotated_lncrna" = "annotated_lncRNA"
)
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0) {
  # Guard: without a catalog the join adds no origin/gene_biotype, and case_when
  # on a missing column errors — the whole report would fail, not just a section.
  if (!("origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)))      de_ann$origin <- NA_character_
  if (!("gene_biotype" %in% colnames(de_ann))) de_ann$gene_biotype <- NA_character_
  if (!("catalog_id" %in% colnames(de_ann)))   de_ann$catalog_id <- NA_character_
  de_ann <- de_ann %>%
    mutate(
      gene_id_stable        = dplyr::coalesce(catalog_id, gene_id),
      significant_padj      = !is.na(padj) & padj < params$fdr,
      significant_padj_lfc1 = !is.na(padj) & padj < params$fdr & abs(log2FoldChange) >= params$lfc,
      gene_group = dplyr::case_when(
        origin %in% names(ORIGIN_TO_GROUP) ~ unname(ORIGIN_TO_GROUP[origin]),
        !is.na(gene_biotype) & gene_biotype == "protein_coding" ~ "protein_coding",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    )
}

# Conservation/synteny gating: a section is only shown when the configured
# module produced data (not merely when the column exists), otherwise an
# all-NA column would render empty/confusing plots. Columns are always present
# in the catalog (NA when the module was skipped).
has_conservation <- isTRUE(params$conservation_configured) &&
  !is.null(catalog) && "conservation_mean" %in% colnames(catalog) &&
  any(!is.na(catalog$conservation_mean))
has_synteny <- isTRUE(params$synteny_configured) &&
  !is.null(catalog) && "syntenic_locus" %in% colnames(catalog) &&
  any(!is.na(catalog$syntenic_locus))

cis <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$cis_pairs, show_col_types = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
cis_sig <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$cis_pairs_sig, show_col_types = FALSE),
                    error = function(e) NULL)

# Annotate cis pairs with DE stats from THIS contrast only
# (left_join keeps all cis rows — lncRNAs without a DE match get NA)
if (!is.null(cis_sig) && nrow(cis_sig) > 0 && !is.null(de_ct) && nrow(de_ct) > 0) {
  cis_sig <- cis_sig %>%
    left_join(
      select(de_ct, gene_id, lncrna_DE_log2FC = log2FoldChange, lncrna_DE_padj = padj),
      by = c("lncrna_id" = "gene_id")
    )
}

ora <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$ora, show_col_types = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
gsea <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$gsea, show_col_types = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) NULL)

# Restrict enrichment tables to the current contrast
if (!is.null(ora) && "contrast" %in% colnames(ora)) {
  ora <- filter(ora, contrast == !!contrast)
}
if (!is.null(gsea) && "contrast" %in% colnames(gsea)) {
  gsea <- filter(gsea, contrast == !!contrast)
}

# Heterogeneity diagnostic (optional feature, off by default): the group-level table is
# a header-only, 0-row placeholder when params.heterogeneity_analysis is disabled for
# this norm_group, so het_ct/het_cv_ct simply end up empty and the section is skipped.
het <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$heterogeneity, show_col_types = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
het_cv <- tryCatch(read_tsv(params$heterogeneity_cv, show_col_types = FALSE),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
het_ct <- if (!is.null(het) && "contrast" %in% colnames(het)) {
  filter(het, contrast == !!contrast)
} else { NULL }
het_cv_ct <- if (!is.null(het_cv) && "contrast" %in% colnames(het_cv)) {
  filter(het_cv, contrast == !!contrast)
} else { NULL }
if (!is.null(het_ct) && nrow(het_ct) > 0 && !is.null(catalog) && nrow(catalog) > 0) {
  het_ct <- het_ct %>%
    left_join(select(catalog, gene_id, gene_name, class_code, catalog_id), by = "gene_id")
}

# Per-sample lncRNA detection from TPM matrix (QC)
tpm <- tryCatch(readRDS(params$tpm), error = function(e) NULL)
coldata <- tryCatch(read.csv(params$coldata, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
has_condition_cols <- !is.null(coldata) && all(c("sample", "condition") %in% colnames(coldata))

# A contrast may be restricted to one batch (4th column of the contrasts file).
# DESeq2 then uses only that batch, so the expression panels must use the same
# samples; otherwise they mix batches the test never saw.
ct_batch <- if (!is.null(de_ct) && "batch_subset" %in% colnames(de_ct)) {
  b <- unique(as.character(de_ct$batch_subset))
  b <- b[!is.na(b) & nzchar(b)]
  if (length(b) == 1 && b != "all") b else NULL
} else NULL
group_has_batch <- !is.null(coldata) && "batch" %in% colnames(coldata) &&
  length(unique(coldata$batch[!is.na(coldata$batch) & nzchar(coldata$batch)])) > 1

# Samples of THIS contrast (numerator/denominator), restricted to the contrast's
# batch when one was used, ordered by condition so the heatmap groups the two groups.
contrast_samples <- if (!is.null(tpm)) colnames(tpm) else NULL
if (!is.null(tpm) && has_condition_cols &&
    nzchar(params$numerator) && nzchar(params$denominator)) {
  keep <- intersect(coldata$sample[coldata$condition %in% c(params$numerator, params$denominator)],
                    colnames(tpm))
  if (!is.null(ct_batch)) {
    keep <- intersect(keep, coldata$sample[coldata$batch %in% ct_batch])
  }
  cond <- coldata$condition[match(keep, coldata$sample)]
  # Denominator (reference/control) first, then numerator, then sample id.
  cond_lvl <- factor(cond, levels = c(params$denominator, params$numerator))
  contrast_samples <- keep[order(cond_lvl, keep)]
}

# Per-condition sample sets (whole group) for the shortlist expression context.
cond_samples_map <- list()
if (has_condition_cols && !is.null(tpm)) {
  for (lvl in unique(coldata$condition)) {
    cond_samples_map[[as.character(lvl)]] <- intersect(coldata$sample[coldata$condition == lvl],
                                                       colnames(tpm))
  }
}

# Direction (sign of the shrunken LFC) and per-condition TPM context for the
# shortlist, computed here once from the group TPM matrix.
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "log2FoldChange" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  de_ann <- de_ann %>%
    mutate(direction = dplyr::case_when(
      !significant_padj ~ "ns",
      is.na(log2FoldChange) ~ "ns",
      log2FoldChange > 0 ~ paste0("up_in_", params$numerator),
      TRUE ~ paste0("down_in_", params$numerator)
    ))
}
if (!is.null(tpm) && !is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0) {
  expr_ctx <- function(lvl) {
    ss <- intersect(cond_samples_map[[as.character(lvl)]], colnames(tpm))
    if (length(ss) == 0) {
      return(list(m = rep(NA_real_, nrow(de_ann)), n = rep(NA_integer_, nrow(de_ann))))
    }
    m <- tpm[de_ann$gene_id, ss, drop = FALSE]
    mm <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE); mm[is.nan(mm)] <- NA_real_
    nn <- rowSums(m >= 1, na.rm = TRUE); nn[is.na(mm)] <- NA_integer_
    list(m = as.numeric(mm), n = as.integer(nn))
  }
  num <- expr_ctx(params$numerator)
  den <- expr_ctx(params$denominator)
  de_ann$mean_tpm_num   <- num$m
  de_ann$mean_tpm_den   <- den$m
  de_ann$n_expressed_num <- num$n
  de_ann$n_expressed_den <- den$n
}

lncrna_per_sample <- NULL
if (!is.null(tpm) && !is.null(catalog) && nrow(catalog) > 0) {
  lncrna_ids <- catalog$gene_id[catalog$origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna")]
  lncrna_ids <- intersect(lncrna_ids, rownames(tpm))
  if (length(lncrna_ids) > 0) {
    tpm_lnc <- tpm[lncrna_ids, , drop = FALSE]
    lncrna_per_sample <- data.frame(
      sample        = colnames(tpm_lnc),
      n_novel       = colSums(tpm_lnc[rownames(tpm_lnc) %in% catalog$gene_id[catalog$origin == "novel"], , drop = FALSE] >= 1),
      n_annotated   = colSums(tpm_lnc[rownames(tpm_lnc) %in% catalog$gene_id[catalog$origin == "annotated_lncrna"], , drop = FALSE] >= 1),
      n_total_lnc   = colSums(tpm_lnc >= 1),
      row.names     = NULL,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

## Analysis overview

```{r analysis-overview}
n_by_cond <- function(lvl) {
  if (is.null(coldata) || !("condition" %in% colnames(coldata))) return(NA_integer_)
  sum(as.character(coldata$condition) == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
}
design_txt <- if (!is.null(params$design_formula) && nzchar(params$design_formula))
  params$design_formula else "not recorded"
ov <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Contrast", "Higher in", "Design formula", "Batch used",
           "Samples (numerator)", "Samples (denominator)",
           "Significance (FDR)", "LFC reference", "Genome build", "Species"),
  Value = c(
    sprintf("%s vs %s", params$numerator, params$denominator),
    sprintf("%s (+log2FC = higher in %s)", params$numerator, params$numerator),
    design_txt,
    if (!is.null(ct_batch)) paste0("single batch: ", ct_batch)
      else if (group_has_batch) "all samples (batch in design)" else "all samples (no batch)",
    as.character(n_by_cond(params$numerator)),
    as.character(n_by_cond(params$denominator)),
    sprintf("padj < %g", params$fdr),
    sprintf("|log2FC| >= %g (visual guide only)", params$lfc),
    if (!is.null(params$genome_build) && nzchar(params$genome_build)) params$genome_build else "not recorded",
    if (!is.null(params$species) && nzchar(params$species)) params$species else "not recorded"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(ov, format = "html", col.names = c("", ""))
```

```{r de-banner, results='asis'}
if (is.null(de_ann) || nrow(de_ann) == 0) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n",
      "No DE rows found for contrast `", contrast, "`. DE-dependent sections will be empty; ",
      "check the contrast label and the DESeq2 log.\n:::\n", sep = "")
}
```

> **How to read this report.** `significant` always means `padj < ` `r params$fdr`;
> `significant_padj_lfc1` is a separate, explicitly labelled column and is never
> the default. Tier is a **structural priority** label, not a confidence score.
> Class `i` on the same strand as its host can be nascent pre-mRNA, and antisense
> calls depend on strand fidelity. `NA` means *not evaluated*, never *clean*.

## Tested catalog

```{r catalog-summary}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  missing_cat <- sum(is.na(de_ann$origin))
  if (missing_cat > 0.05 * nrow(de_ann)) {
    cat(sprintf("WARNING: %d / %d tested genes missing from gene catalog (possible gene_id drift between tx2gene and catalog).\n",
                missing_cat, nrow(de_ann)))
  }
  cat_sum <- de_ann %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tested   = n(),
      n_sig      = sum(significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_lfc1 = sum(significant_padj_lfc1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(origin_label = dplyr::coalesce(ORIGIN_LABELS[origin], origin, "unknown")) %>%
    select(origin_label, n_tested, n_sig, n_sig_lfc1) %>%
    arrange(origin_label)
kable(cat_sum, format = "html",
        col.names = c("Origin", "Genes tested",
                      sprintf("Significant (padj<%g)", params$fdr),
                      sprintf("Significant & |LFC|>=%g", params$lfc)))
} else {
  cat("No gene catalog available for this report.")
}
```

*"Other reference genes (background)" (protein-coding and other non-lncRNA reference genes) are tested and shipped in full in `de_full.tsv`; they only provide the enrichment background — this report focuses on lncRNAs.*

## lncRNA detection per sample (QC)

Number of lncRNAs (novel + annotated) detected per sample at TPM >= 1.
This figure covers all samples in the norm_group (not only this contrast's conditions).

```{r lncrna-per-sample, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (!is.null(lncrna_per_sample) && nrow(lncrna_per_sample) > 0) {
  lps_long <- lncrna_per_sample %>%
    pivot_longer(c(n_novel, n_annotated, n_total_lnc),
                 names_to = "type", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(type = recode(type,
      n_novel       = "Novel",
      n_annotated   = "Annotated (reference)",
      n_total_lnc   = "Total lncRNA"
    ))
  p <- ggplot(lps_long, aes(reorder(sample, n), n, fill = type)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Novel"                 = "#c2185b",
      "Annotated (reference)" = "#2e7d32",
      "Total lncRNA"          = "#1a237e"
    )) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "N lncRNAs detected (TPM >= 1)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("TPM matrix not available for this report.\n")
}
```

### lncRNA position relative to protein-coding genes

Tested and significant lncRNAs (novel + annotated) by where they sit relative to
protein-coding genes (`lnc_position_class`). `significant_padj` is `padj < FDR`;
`significant_padj_lfc1` additionally requires `|log2FC| >= LFC`.

```{r position-class-summary}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    all(c("origin", "lnc_position_class") %in% colnames(de_ann))) {
  pos_tab <- de_ann %>%
    filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna"),
           !is.na(lnc_position_class), lnc_position_class != "NA") %>%
    group_by(origin, lnc_position_class) %>%
    summarise(
      tested                = n(),
      significant_padj      = sum(significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      significant_padj_lfc1 = sum(significant_padj_lfc1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(origin_label = dplyr::coalesce(ORIGIN_LABELS[origin], origin, "unknown")) %>%
    select(origin_label, lnc_position_class, tested, significant_padj,
           significant_padj_lfc1) %>%
    arrange(origin_label, desc(tested))
  if (nrow(pos_tab) > 0) {
    kable(pos_tab, format = "html",
          col.names = c("origin", "lnc_position_class", "tested",
                        "significant_padj", "significant_padj_lfc1"))
  } else {
    cat("No lncRNAs with a position class for this contrast.\n")
  }
}
```

### Novel lncRNA class codes (GFFCOMPARE)

For **novel** lncRNAs only, GFFCOMPARE assigns a `class_code` describing the
relationship between the transcript and the reference annotation. A gene whose
transcripts carry several codes is counted once per code (the `Total` row is the
count of unique genes, so the per-class rows are not additive).

```{r class-code-summary}
novel_de <- if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  de_ann %>% filter(origin == "novel")
} else {
  NULL
}
if (!is.null(novel_de) && nrow(novel_de) > 0) {
  cc_sum <- novel_de %>%
    mutate(cc_simple = coalesce(class_code, "unknown")) %>%
    separate_rows(cc_simple, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    filter(nzchar(cc_simple)) %>%
    group_by(class_code = cc_simple) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tested   = n_distinct(gene_id),
      n_sig      = n_distinct(gene_id[significant_padj]),
      n_sig_lfc1 = n_distinct(gene_id[significant_padj_lfc1]),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(interpretation = ifelse(
      class_code == "unknown",
      "No GFFCOMPARE class assigned",
      coalesce(unname(CLASS_CODE_LEGEND[class_code]), class_code)
    )) %>%
    select(class_code, interpretation, n_tested, n_sig, n_sig_lfc1) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_tested))
  cc_sum <- bind_rows(cc_sum, data.frame(
    class_code     = "Total (unique genes)",
    interpretation = "All classes combined",
    n_tested       = n_distinct(novel_de$gene_id),
    n_sig          = n_distinct(novel_de$gene_id[novel_de$significant_padj]),
    n_sig_lfc1     = n_distinct(novel_de$gene_id[novel_de$significant_padj_lfc1])
  ))
  cat(sprintf("Novel lncRNAs tested: %d  |  Significant (padj<%g): %d\n\n",
              nrow(novel_de), params$fdr,
              sum(novel_de$significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE)))
  kable(cc_sum, format = "html",
        col.names = c("class_code", "Interpretation", "Tested",
                      sprintf("Significant (padj<%g)", params$fdr),
                      sprintf("Significant & |LFC|>=%g", params$lfc)))
} else {
  cat("No novel lncRNAs tested for this contrast.\n")
}
```

### Novel significant lncRNAs in external catalogs

The `novel` call is only as strong as the external evidence behind it. For the
**novel lncRNAs significant in this contrast**, this shows how many are in fact a
strict reciprocal hit in a configured external catalog and in which one. It reads
the per-source `in_<source>` flags directly — no text list is parsed, so a
non-evaluated source (NA) can never be mistaken for a source with no hit.

```{r novel-catalog-overlap, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
NOVEL_CATALOG_SOURCES <- c("lncipedia", "noncode", "rnacentral", "fantomcat")
# Tolerant of logical or "TRUE"/"FALSE" text: read_tsv normally returns logical.
is_true <- function(x) !is.na(x) & as.character(x) %in% c("TRUE", "true", "1")

if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  novel_sig <- de_ann %>% filter(origin == "novel", significant_padj)

  # Only sources evaluated in this run: an all-NA in_<src> column means the
  # catalog was not configured (absent evidence, not a negative result).
  present <- NOVEL_CATALOG_SOURCES[
    vapply(NOVEL_CATALOG_SOURCES, function(s) {
      col <- paste0("in_", s)
      col %in% colnames(de_ann) && any(!is.na(de_ann[[col]]))
    }, logical(1))]

  if (nrow(novel_sig) > 0) {
    absent_label <- if (length(present) == 0) "Not evaluated (no catalog)" else "Not in any catalog"
    hit_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(novel_sig)), function(i) {
      present[vapply(present, function(s) is_true(novel_sig[[paste0("in_", s)]][i]), logical(1))]
    })

    pie_df <- data.frame(
      group = vapply(hit_list, function(h)
        if (length(h) == 0) absent_label else paste(h, collapse = " + "),
        character(1)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) %>%
      count(group, name = "n") %>%
      mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c(absent_label,
                  sort(setdiff(unique(group), absent_label)))),
        pct   = 100 * n / sum(n),
        label = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, pct)
      ) %>%
      arrange(group)

    p <- ggplot(pie_df, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = group)) +
      geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
      coord_polar(theta = "y") +
      geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5) +
      labs(title = sprintf("Novel significant lncRNAs by external-catalog membership (n=%d)",
                           nrow(novel_sig)),
           fill = NULL) +
      theme_void()
    print(p)

    save_fig("novel_catalog_overlap", p, width = 7, height = 6)

    n_hit <- sum(vapply(hit_list, length, integer(1)) > 0)
    per_src <- data.frame(
      catalog = present,
      n = vapply(present, function(s)
        sum(vapply(hit_list, function(h) s %in% h, logical(1))), integer(1)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    kable(bind_rows(
        data.frame(catalog = c("Novel significant (total)", "In >=1 catalog", absent_label),
                   n = c(nrow(novel_sig), n_hit, nrow(novel_sig) - n_hit)),
        per_src),
      format = "html", col.names = c("Group", "Genes"))
  } else {
    cat("No significant novel lncRNAs in this contrast.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("External-catalog evidence not available for this contrast.\n")
}
```

## DE summary

Number of lncRNAs (novel + annotated) tested in this contrast and how many changed,
with direction.

```{r de-summary}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  lnc_de <- de_ann %>% filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna"))
  sum_tab <- lnc_de %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    summarise(
      tested      = n(),
      significant = sum(significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE),
      up          = sum(significant_padj & log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      down        = sum(significant_padj & log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sig_lfc1    = sum(significant_padj_lfc1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(origin_label = dplyr::coalesce(ORIGIN_LABELS[origin], origin, "unknown")) %>%
    select(origin_label, tested, significant, up, down, sig_lfc1)
  sum_tab <- bind_rows(sum_tab, data.frame(
    origin_label = "Total (lncRNAs)",
    tested      = nrow(lnc_de),
    significant = sum(lnc_de$significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE),
    up          = sum(lnc_de$significant_padj & lnc_de$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    down        = sum(lnc_de$significant_padj & lnc_de$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_lfc1    = sum(lnc_de$significant_padj_lfc1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))
  kable(sum_tab, format = "html",
        col.names = c("Origin", "Tested",
                      sprintf("Significant (padj<%g)", params$fdr), "Up", "Down",
                      sprintf("Significant & |LFC|>=%g", params$lfc)))
} else {
  cat("No differential expression results found for this contrast.\n\n")
  cat("The contrast was declared in the analysis but no DE output was recorded upstream.")
  cat("This usually means DESeq2 skipped or failed it (e.g. missing condition level or too few samples in a batch subset).")
  cat("Check the pipeline log for `SKIP`/`ERROR` lines mentioning this contrast.\n")
}
```

### Volcano plot

Three views (tabs): all lncRNAs (annotated + novel), annotated only, novel only. Colored by
`origin`; point size marks **`significant_padj`** (`padj < FDR`). The y-axis is
`-log10(padj)`, so the dashed line at `padj = FDR` separates significant from
non-significant. The dotted lines are `+/-LFC`, shown as a **visual reference only**
(they do not define significance). Genes with `padj = NA` (independent filtering) are
not drawn. The top 20 significant by padj are labeled with the gene symbol, else
`catalog_id`, else `gene_id`. Each view is also written as a PDF under `plots/`.

```{r volcano-setup}
volcano_base <- NULL
volcano_plot <- NULL
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    all(c("log2FoldChange", "padj") %in% colnames(de_ann))) {
  volcano_base <- de_ann %>%
    filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna"), !is.na(padj), padj > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      sig    = ifelse(significant_padj, "sig", "ns"),
      origin = ifelse(is.na(origin), "reference_other", origin),
      logp   = -log10(padj),
      label  = coalesce(gene_name, catalog_id, gene_id)
    )
  dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
  # Shared builder so the three tabs differ only in subset and title.
  volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
    ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange, logp)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = origin, size = sig), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = filter(df, sig == "sig") %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice_head(n = 20),
        aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0.2
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = ORIGIN_COLORS[sort(unique(df$origin))],
        labels = ORIGIN_LABELS[sort(unique(df$origin))],
        na.value = "#7f7f7f"
      ) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("sig" = 3, "ns" = 0.8)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$lfc, params$lfc), linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.4) +
      labs(title = title, color = "Origin",
           size = sprintf("Significant (padj<%g)", params$fdr)) +
      theme_minimal()
  }
  render_volcano <- function(df, title, file) {
    p <- volcano_plot(df, title)
    print(p)
    save_fig(sub("\\.pdf$", "", file), p, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}
```

### MA plot

Mean-difference plot for the same contrast: `log2FoldChange` against the mean
normalized count (`log10(baseMean)`), colored by `origin`. Genes with `baseMean == 0`
are dropped.

```{r ma-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    all(c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange") %in% colnames(de_ann))) {
  ma_df <- de_ann %>%
    filter(!is.na(baseMean) & baseMean > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      origin = ifelse(is.na(origin), "reference_other", origin),
      sig    = ifelse(significant_padj, "sig", "ns")
    )
  if (nrow(ma_df) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(ma_df, aes(log10(baseMean), log2FoldChange)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = origin, size = sig), alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = ORIGIN_COLORS[sort(unique(ma_df$origin))],
        labels = ORIGIN_LABELS[sort(unique(ma_df$origin))],
        na.value = "#7f7f7f"
      ) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("sig" = 3, "ns" = 0.8)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
      labs(x = "log10(baseMean)", y = "log2FoldChange",

      theme_minimal()
    print(p)

    save_fig("ma", p, width = 8, height = 6)
  } else {
    cat("No genes with baseMean > 0 — MA plot skipped.\n")
  }
} else {

```

### Top DE genes and lncRNAs

The panels most people expect from a DE analysis: a heatmap of the strongest
changes and, for lncRNAs, per-sample expression. Selection is the top N by
absolute `log2FoldChange` **among `significant_padj` genes** (`padj < FDR`), so a
contrast with few significant genes still produces a figure. Rows are row z-scores
of log2 TPM; columns are this contrast's samples (restricted to `batch_subset` when
the contrast used one), with the denominator group first. Each panel is also written
as `plots/heatmap_top.png|pdf`, `plots/heatmap_top_lncrna.png|pdf` and
`plots/top_lncrna_expression.png|pdf`.

```{r heatmap-helpers, include=FALSE}
# Row z-score of log2 TPM for the given genes across the given samples.
# Returns NULL when there is nothing to draw.
build_expr_long <- function(ids, samples, value = "z") {
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(tpm))
  if (is.null(ids) || length(ids) == 0 || length(samples) == 0) return(NULL)
  mat <- log2(tpm[ids, samples, drop = FALSE] + 1)
  if (value == "z") {
    z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
    zdf <- as.data.frame(z, check.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    zdf <- as.data.frame(mat, check.names = FALSE)
  }
  zdf$gene_id <- rownames(zdf)
  long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(zdf, -gene_id, names_to = "sample", values_to = value)
  long$condition <- if (!is.null(coldata) && "condition" %in% colnames(coldata))
    coldata$condition[match(long$sample, coldata$sample)] else "all"
  # Denominator facet first, then numerator.
  long$condition <- factor(long$condition,
                           levels = intersect(c(params$denominator, params$numerator),
                                              unique(long$condition)))
  lab <- NULL
  if (!is.null(de_ann) && "gene_id" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
    id_cols <- intersect(c("gene_name", "gene_id_stable"), colnames(de_ann))
    lab <- if (length(id_cols) > 0) {
      do.call(dplyr::coalesce, c(unname(as.list(de_ann[, id_cols, drop = FALSE])),
                                 list(de_ann$gene_id)))
    } else {
      de_ann$gene_id
    }
    lab <- setNames(lab, de_ann$gene_id)
  }
  long$label <- if (!is.null(lab)) dplyr::coalesce(unname(lab[long$gene_id]), long$gene_id) else long$gene_id
  # Keep the caller's ranking on the y-axis instead of alphabetical order.
  long$label <- factor(long$label, levels = unique(long$label[order(match(long$gene_id, ids))]))
  long$sample <- factor(long$sample, levels = samples)
  long
}

plot_heatmap <- function(long, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  ggplot(long, aes(sample, label, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(~condition, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1565c0", mid = "white", high = "#b71c1c",
                         midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey90") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "row z")
}
```

```{r heatmap-top-genes, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(tpm) && !is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    "significant_padj" %in% colnames(de_ann) &&
    !is.null(contrast_samples) && length(contrast_samples) >= 2) {
  top_genes <- de_ann %>%
    filter(significant_padj) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 50)
  lg <- build_expr_long(top_genes$gene_id, contrast_samples)
  if (!is.null(lg) && nrow(lg) > 0) {
    p <- plot_heatmap(lg, sprintf("Top %d DE genes by |LFC| (row z-score)",
                                  dplyr::n_distinct(lg$gene_id)),
                      if (group_has_batch) "batch is in the design; z-score is not batch-corrected" else NULL)
    print(p)
    save_fig("heatmap_top", p, 9, 8)
  } else {
    cat("No significant genes for the heatmap.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No DE data / TPM matrix for the gene heatmap.\n")
}
```

### Significant genes per chromosome

Genes with `significant_padj` (padj < FDR) grouped by chromosome, split by `gene_group`
(top). The bottom panel is the within-chromosome significance rate
(`significant / tested`), which separates a chromosome enriched in changes from
one that is merely large. Non-canonical contigs (patches, scaffolds) are dropped.
The panel is also written as a PDF under `plots/`.

```{r chromosome-sig, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
CANON_CHR <- c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y", "MT")
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    all(c("chromosome", "gene_group") %in% colnames(de_ann))) {
  chr_df <- de_ann %>% filter(chromosome %in% CANON_CHR)
  if (nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
    cnt <- chr_df %>%
      group_by(chromosome, gene_group) %>%
      summarise(value = sum(significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(panel = "significant genes", fill = gene_group)
    fr <- chr_df %>%
      group_by(chromosome) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(significant_padj, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(panel = "fraction significant (of tested)", fill = "all")
    dd <- bind_rows(cnt, fr) %>%
      mutate(
        chromosome = factor(chromosome, levels = CANON_CHR),
        panel = factor(panel, levels = c("significant genes",
                                         "fraction significant (of tested)"))
      )
    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(chromosome, value, fill = fill)) +
      geom_col() +
      facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
      labs(title = "Significant genes per chromosome", x = "chromosome",
           y = "genes / fraction", fill = NULL)
    print(p)
    save_fig("sig_genes_by_chromosome", p, width = 9, height = 9)
  } else {
    cat("No canonical chromosomes in this contrast.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No DE data for this contrast — chromosome panel skipped.\n")
}
```

### Significant lncRNAs by position class

Significant lncRNAs (`significant_padj`: padj < FDR) split by `lnc_position_class`
(where the lncRNA sits relative to protein-coding genes) and direction. Novel and
annotated lncRNAs are pooled; the full table is in `de_lncrna_full.tsv` and the
significant-only lncRNA view in `de_lncrna_significant.tsv`. The panel
is also written as a PDF under `plots/`.

```{r sig-position-class, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 &&
    all(c("origin", "lnc_position_class") %in% colnames(de_ann))) {
  pos_df <- de_ann %>%
    filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna"),
           !is.na(lnc_position_class), lnc_position_class != "NA",
           significant_padj) %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "significant (up)",
                              "significant (down)")) %>%
    count(lnc_position_class, direction)
  if (nrow(pos_df) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(pos_df, aes(n, lnc_position_class, fill = direction)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("significant (up)"   = "#b71c1c",
                                   "significant (down)" = "#1565c0")) +
      labs(title = "Significant lncRNAs by position class", x = "N genes",
           y = "lnc_position_class", fill = NULL) +
      theme_minimal()
    print(p)
    save_fig("sig_lncrna_position_class", p, width = 9, height = 6)
  } else {
    cat("No significant lncRNAs for this contrast.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No lncRNA DE data for this contrast — position-class panel skipped.\n")
}
```

### Significant lncRNAs by class

Significant genes only, split by direction (red = up, blue = down) and shown
side by side per class. Novel class combinations without significant genes are
omitted to keep the panel readable.

```{r class-barplot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
lnc_by_class <- NULL
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  lnc_by_class <- de_ann %>%
    filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna")) %>%
    mutate(
      label  = ifelse(origin == "novel",
                      coalesce(class_code, "unknown"),
                      coalesce(gene_biotype, "lncRNA")),
      origin_label = dplyr::coalesce(ORIGIN_LABELS[origin], origin, "unknown"),
      status = case_when(
        significant_padj & log2FoldChange > 0  ~ "significant (up)",
        significant_padj                        ~ "significant (down)",
        TRUE                                    ~ "not significant"
      )
    ) %>%
    count(origin_label, label, status) %>%
    complete(nesting(origin_label, label),
             status = c("not significant", "significant (up)", "significant (down)"),
             fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    filter(status != "not significant") %>%
    group_by(origin_label, label) %>%
    mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(origin_label != ORIGIN_LABELS["novel"] | total > 0) %>%
    group_by(origin_label) %>%
    mutate(label = stats::reorder(label, total)) %>%
    ungroup()
}
if (!is.null(lnc_by_class) && nrow(lnc_by_class) > 0) {
  p <- ggplot(lnc_by_class, aes(n, label, fill = status)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    facet_wrap(~origin_label, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "significant (up)"   = "#b71c1c",
      "significant (down)" = "#1565c0"
    )) +
    labs(x = "N genes", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("No lncRNA genes tested for this contrast.")
}
```
#### Counts by class and origin
```{r class-summary-table, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(catalog) && nrow(catalog) > 0 &&
    !is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0) {
  lnc_origins <- c("novel", "annotated_lncrna")
  class_label <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      mutate(
        origin = ifelse(is.na(origin), "reference_other", origin),
        label  = ifelse(origin == "novel",
                        dplyr::coalesce(fmt_class_label(class_code), "unknown"),
                        coalesce(gene_biotype, "lncRNA"))
      ) %>%
      filter(origin %in% lnc_origins)
  }
  cls_cat <- class_label(catalog) %>% count(origin, label, name = "in_catalog")
  cls_de  <- class_label(de_ann) %>%
    group_by(origin, label) %>%
    summarise(
      tested          = n(),
      sig_up          = sum(significant_padj & log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sig_down        = sum(significant_padj & log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_baseMean = median(baseMean, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups         = "drop"
    )
  cls_tab <- cls_cat %>%
    full_join(cls_de, by = c("origin", "label")) %>%
    mutate(
      origin_label = dplyr::coalesce(ORIGIN_LABELS[origin], origin, "unknown"),
      across(c(in_catalog, tested, sig_up, sig_down), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
    ) %>%
    select(origin_label, label, in_catalog, tested, sig_up, sig_down, median_baseMean) %>%
    arrange(origin_label, desc(in_catalog))
  cat('<details><summary><b>Counts by class and origin — click to expand</b></summary>\n')
  cat(render_widget_html(datatable(
    round_numeric_cols(cls_tab),
    colnames = c("Class / origin", "Class", "In catalog", "Tested",
                   "Significant up", "Significant down", "Median baseMean"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 25))))
  cat('\n</details>\n')
} else {
  cat("No catalog or DE data available for the class summary table.")
}
```

### DE tables

Annotated/novel tabs list **significant** lncRNAs (`significant_padj`, i.e.
`padj < ` `r params$fdr`), and keep `significant_padj_lfc1` as an explicit column
for the extra `|log2FoldChange| >= ` `r params$lfc` cutoff.
Tables are capped at `r DE_TABLE_CAP` rows (lowest padj first); the complete tables are
`de_lncrna_significant.tsv` (FDR) and `de_lncrna_full.tsv`. The Overview tab lists the
**significant** genes (all groups, `protein_coding`/`other` included), also capped;
its complete table is `de_full.tsv` (filter `significant_padj`).

```{r de-table-cap}
# Positions come from the gene catalog (chr/start/end/strand); gene_group marks
# lncRNA vs coding. Both are inside the row, not a separate lookup.
DE_VIEW_COLS <- c("gene_id", "gene_id_stable", "catalog_id", "gene_name", "gene_group", "origin", "gene_biotype",
                  "chromosome", "start", "end", "strand", "locus", "class_code", "class_code_label",
                  "lnc_position_class",
                  "ref_gene_name", "known_catalog_hit",
                  "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "pvalue", "padj",
                  "significant_padj", "significant_padj_lfc1")

# External-catalog evidence columns kept together so a per-source boolean sits
# next to its best id and pct.
DE_EVIDENCE_COLS <- c("novelty_class", "catalog_sources", "n_tx_hit", "n_tx",
                      "in_noncode", "noncode_best_id", "noncode_best_pct",
                      "in_rnacentral", "rnacentral_best_id", "rnacentral_best_pct",
                      "in_lncipedia", "lncipedia_best_id", "lncipedia_best_pct",
                      "in_fantomcat", "fantomcat_best_id", "fantomcat_best_pct")

render_de_table <- function(df, cap = DE_TABLE_CAP) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) { cat("No rows.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  # A finite cap truncates to the lowest-padj rows and points at the deliverables;
  # cap = Inf would show every row (not used: the lncRNA tabs are capped too).
  truncated <- is.finite(cap) && nrow(df) > cap
  shown <- if (is.finite(cap)) utils::head(df, cap) else df
  if (truncated) {
    cat(sprintf("\n*Showing the %d lowest-padj of %d rows; the complete table is in the deliverables.*\n\n",
                cap, nrow(df)))
  }
  # Returned (not printed inside the function) so the calling chunk auto-prints it.
  datatable(round_numeric_cols(shown), filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 20))
}
```

## Candidate shortlist (qPCR)

One row per **significant** lncRNA (`padj < ` `r params$fdr`), ordered by padj. The
expression context (`mean_tpm_*`, `n_expressed_*`) is the group mean and the number
of samples at TPM >= 1 per condition. Tier is a structural priority label, not a
confidence score. Conservation and cis columns appear only when those modules ran.

```{r shortlist}
if (!is.null(de_ann) && nrow(de_ann) > 0 && "origin" %in% colnames(de_ann)) {
  sl <- de_ann %>%
    filter(origin %in% c("novel", "annotated_lncrna"), significant_padj) %>%
    mutate(class_code = fmt_class_label(class_code)) %>%
    arrange(padj)

  # Best cis partner per lncRNA (lowest padj), only if cis was computed.
  cs <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cis_sig) && nrow(cis_sig) > 0 &&
      all(c("lncrna_id", "padj") %in% colnames(cis_sig))) {
    cs <- cis_sig %>%
      select(lncrna_id, cis_target_gene_name = target_gene_name,
             cis_rho = spearman_rho, cis_padj = padj, any_of("loo_sign_stable")) %>%
      arrange(cis_padj) %>%
      distinct(lncrna_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
    sl <- sl %>% left_join(cs, by = c("gene_id" = "lncrna_id"))
  }

  cols <- c("gene_name", "catalog_id", "origin", "tier", "class_code",
            "lnc_position_class", "ref_gene_name",
            "log2FoldChange", "padj", "direction", "baseMean",
            "mean_tpm_num", "mean_tpm_den", "n_expressed_num", "n_expressed_den",
            "known_catalog_hit",
            "single_exon_low_confidence", "antisense_status", "x_host_leak_suspect")
  if (has_conservation) cols <- c(cols, "conservation_mean")
  if (!is.null(cs) && "cis_target_gene_name" %in% colnames(sl)) {
    cols <- c(cols, "cis_target_gene_name", "cis_rho", "cis_padj", "loo_sign_stable")
  }

  sl_tab <- sl %>% select(any_of(c("gene_id", cols)))
  if (nrow(sl_tab) > 0) {
    datatable(round_numeric_cols(sl_tab), filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 20))
  } else {
    cat("No significant lncRNAs for this contrast.\n")
  }
}
```

## Cis-regulatory associations

lncRNAs often act on nearby genes. For every lncRNA (novel or annotated) this analysis
tests Spearman correlation between its expression and every protein-coding gene within
&plusmn;`r format(params$cis_window, big.mark = ",")` bp, using the whole norm_group.
By default the correlation runs on **within-condition residuals** of a VST matrix
(batch removed when the group has more than one batch), and **same-strand overlapping
pairs are excluded** because they share reads by construction; antisense overlaps are
kept. Pairs below the FDR threshold are candidate
cis-regulatory targets (`target_gene_id`/`target_gene_name`) — a starting point for
follow-up, not proof of causality. `spearman_rho` gives the direction/strength of the
correlation and `padj` the BH-corrected significance. With ~10 samples the test is
low-powered, and a correlation can be driven by a single influential sample or by rank
ties in a low-expression vector. `loo_sign_stable` (does the sign survive dropping any
one sample?) and `loo_min_abs_rho` (weakest `|rho|` across those drops) flag that:
prefer candidates with `loo_sign_stable == TRUE` and a `loo_min_abs_rho` well away from 0.
The lncRNA side is described by `lncrna_origin` (novel/annotated), `lncrna_class_code`
(GFFCOMPARE code, novel only) and `lncrna_position_class`
(antisense/intronic/overlapping/no_coding_overlap, defined for every lncRNA).

```{r cis}
if (!is.null(cis_sig) && nrow(cis_sig) > 0) {
  cat("Significant cis pairs:\n")
  cis_tab <- round_numeric_cols(cis_sig) %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      "lncrna_id", "lncrna_catalog_id", "lncrna_origin",
      "lncrna_class_code", "lncrna_position_class",
      "target_gene_id", "target_gene_name",
      "spearman_rho", "spearman_pvalue", "padj", "p_method", "df_effective", "n_samples",
      "loo_min_abs_rho", "loo_sign_stable", "loo_max_delta",
      "lncrna_DE_log2FC", "lncrna_DE_padj")))
  datatable(cis_tab, options = list(pageLength = 20))
} else {
  cat("No significant cis-regulatory associations found.\n")
}
```

```{r ora-dotplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
  top_ora <- ora %>%

         size = "Count", color = "p.adjust") +
```

## Functional enrichment — GSEA

```{r gsea-ridgeplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
if (!is.null(gsea) && nrow(gsea) > 0 && "core_enrichment" %in% colnames(gsea) &&
    !is.null(de_ct) && nrow(de_ct) > 0) {
  rank_col <- if ("stat" %in% colnames(de_ct)) "stat" else "log2FoldChange"
  rank_label <- if (rank_col == "stat") "DE test statistic" else "log2 fold-change"
  top_gsea <- gsea %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
  ridge_df <- top_gsea %>%
    select(Description, core_enrichment) %>%
    separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/") %>%
    rename(gene_id = core_enrichment) %>%
    left_join(select(de_ct, gene_id, all_of(rank_col)), by = "gene_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[rank_col]]))
  if (nrow(ridge_df) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(ridge_df, aes(.data[[rank_col]], reorder(Description, .data[[rank_col]], FUN = median))) +
      geom_density_ridges(fill = "#6a1b9a", alpha = 0.6) +
      labs(title = "Top 10 GSEA terms", x = rank_label, y = NULL) +
      theme_minimal()
    print(p)
    save_fig("enrichment_gsea", p, 7, 5)
  } else {
    cat("Core-enrichment genes did not match the DE summary — ridgeplot skipped.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r gsea, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(gsea) && nrow(gsea) > 0) {
  cat('<details><summary><b>Full GSEA results table — click to expand</b></summary>\n')

    datatable(round_numeric_cols(compact_list_columns(gsea)), escape = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20))))
  cat('\n</details>\n')
} else {
  cat("_No GSEA gene sets passed the significance threshold for this contrast. This is expected when no coordinated shift exists across the ranked gene list; see ORA above for the single-gene test._\n")
}
```

```{r heterogeneity-check, include=FALSE}
# Off by default: het_ct/het_cv_ct are NULL (or 0 rows) unless
# params.heterogeneity_analysis is enabled for this norm_group, in which case this
# whole section is skipped and the report is identical to the pre-feature pipeline.
show_heterogeneity <- !is.null(het_ct) && nrow(het_ct) > 0
```

`r if (show_heterogeneity) "## Heterogeneity Analysis"`

```{r heterogeneity-intro, results='asis'}
if (show_heterogeneity) {
  cat('<div style="text-align: justify;">\n\n')
  cat("Complementary, patient-level diagnostic (Carrasco-Leon et al. 2021, *Leukemia*):",
      "a standard group-mean DE test can miss lncRNAs whose expression is heterogeneous",
      "across individual case samples. This does not replace the DESeq2 result above.\n\n")
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r heterogeneity-cv-plot, eval=show_heterogeneity, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
if (!is.null(het_cv_ct) && nrow(het_cv_ct) > 0) {
  p <- ggplot(het_cv_ct, aes(origin_group, cv, fill = origin_group)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "CV (log2 TPM, case samples)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  print(p)

  cv_stats <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("lncRNA CV", "Coding CV", "Welch t-test"),
    Value = c(
      sprintf("mean = %.3f (n = %d)",
              unique(het_cv_ct$mean_cv_lncrna)[1],
              unique(het_cv_ct$n_lncrna_genes)[1]),
      sprintf("mean = %.3f (n = %d)",
              unique(het_cv_ct$mean_cv_coding)[1],
              unique(het_cv_ct$n_coding_genes)[1]),
      sprintf("t = %.3f, p = %.3g",
              unique(het_cv_ct$t_statistic)[1],
              unique(het_cv_ct$p_value)[1])
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  kable(cv_stats, format = "html", col.names = c("Metric", "Value"))
} else {

}
```

### Altered lncRNAs missed by the standard DE test

Genes called "altered" by sample-level concordance (concordant in
&ge;`r round(100 * params$heterogeneity_concordant_frac)`% of case samples,
discordant in <`r round(100 * params$heterogeneity_discordant_frac)`%) that
were **not** already significant (`padj < ` `r params$fdr`) in the main
DESeq2 contrast — the actual
value-add of this diagnostic.

```{r heterogeneity-table}
if (show_heterogeneity) {
  de_sig_ids <- if (!is.null(de_ct) && all(c("gene_id", "padj") %in% colnames(de_ct))) {
    de_ct$gene_id[!is.na(de_ct$padj) & de_ct$padj < params$fdr]
  } else character()

  tab <- het_ct %>%
    filter(altered_call == "altered", !(gene_id %in% de_sig_ids)) %>%
    select(any_of(c("gene_id", "catalog_id", "gene_name", "class_code", "direction",
                    "concordant_frac", "discordant_frac", "n_case", "n_control")))
  if (nrow(tab) > 0) {
    datatable(round_numeric_cols(tab), filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 20))
  } else {
    cat("No additional altered lncRNAs found beyond the standard DESeq2 result.\n")
  }
}
```

## Conservation

```{r conservation}
if (has_conservation) {
  cat(sprintf("Metric: %s (build: %s)\n\n",
              params$conservation_metric, params$genome_build))
  # Scoped to genes tested in this contrast (de_ann), not the whole catalog —
  # otherwise every report would show the same genome-wide summary.
  cons_data <- de_ann %>% filter(!is.na(conservation_mean))
  cons_sum <- cons_data %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    summarise(
      n           = n(),
      mean_score  = round(mean(conservation_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      pct_conserved = round(100 * mean(conservation_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups     = "drop"
    )
  if (nrow(cons_sum) > 0) {
    kable(cons_sum, format = "html")
  } else {
    cat("No tested genes with conservation data for this contrast.")
    if (sum(de_ann$origin == "novel", na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      cat("This is expected when no novel lncRNAs passed the DESeq2 independent filtering step")
      cat("for this contrast (e.g. low-abundance novel transcripts in primary samples with shallow sequencing).")
    }
    cat("Conservation scores are only computed for novel lncRNAs.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Conservation not evaluated for this run (conservation_bigwig not configured).\n")
}
```

### Conservation vs differential expression

Splits the same genes by DE outcome in this contrast — is conservation higher or
lower among the ones that actually changed?

```{r conservation-by-sig}
if (has_conservation && exists("cons_data") && nrow(cons_data) > 0 && "padj" %in% colnames(cons_data)) {
  cons_by_sig <- cons_data %>%
    mutate(sig = ifelse(significant_padj, "significant", "not significant")) %>%
    group_by(origin, sig) %>%
    summarise(
      n             = n(),
      mean_score    = round(mean(conservation_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      pct_conserved = round(100 * mean(conservation_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups       = "drop"
    )
  if (nrow(cons_by_sig) > 0) {
    kable(cons_by_sig, format = "html")
  }
}
```

## Synteny

```{r synteny}
if (has_synteny) {
  cat(sprintf("Target species: %s\n\n", params$synteny_target_species))
  # Scoped to genes tested in this contrast (de_ann), not the whole catalog —
  # otherwise every report would show the same genome-wide summary.
  syn_data <- de_ann %>% filter(!is.na(syntenic_locus))
  syn_sum <- syn_data %>%
    group_by(origin) %>%
    summarise(
      n             = n(),
      n_syntenic    = sum(syntenic_locus == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_syntenic  = round(100 * mean(syntenic_locus == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups       = "drop"
    )
  if (nrow(syn_sum) > 0) {
    kable(syn_sum, format = "html")
  } else {
    cat("No tested genes with synteny data for this contrast.")
    if (sum(de_ann$origin == "novel", na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
      cat("This is expected when no novel lncRNAs passed the DESeq2 independent filtering step")
      cat("for this contrast (e.g. low-abundance novel transcripts in primary samples with shallow sequencing).")
    }
    cat("Synteny checks are only computed for novel lncRNAs.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Synteny not evaluated for this run (synteny_chain_file/synteny_target_gtf not configured).\n")
}
```

### Significant novel lncRNAs with a syntenic locus

Candidate orthologous loci in `r params$synteny_target_species` — a starting point for
cross-species follow-up, not proof of conserved function.

```{r synteny-top-table}
if (has_synteny && exists("syn_data")) {
  top_syn <- syn_data %>%
    filter(origin == "novel", syntenic_locus == TRUE, significant_padj) %>%
    select(any_of(c("gene_id", "catalog_id", "gene_name", "class_code",
                    "syntenic_target_gene_id",
                    "log2FoldChange", "padj")))
  if (nrow(top_syn) > 0) {
    datatable(round_numeric_cols(top_syn), filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10))
  } else {
    cat("No significant novel lncRNAs with a syntenic locus in this contrast.\n")
  }
}
```

## Supplementary material (stable catalog identity)

The novel lncRNAs in this run carry stable hierarchical catalog IDs (gene + transcript)
assigned by a persistent two-level registry. The catalog tables are part of the
deliverables, under `deliverables/catalog/`:

- `catalog_genes.tsv` — gene-level catalog with `catalog_id`, coordinates (`chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `strand`), `gene_group`, class codes and tiers.
- `novel_lncrnas.tsv` — novel-only subset of the catalog (same columns).
- `catalog_tx.tsv` — transcript-level mapping (`transcript_id`, `parent` gene `catalog_id`, structural signature).
- `annotation/lncrna_catalog.gtf` — frozen novel transcripts renamed with catalog IDs.
- `annotation/lncrna_catalog.fa` — catalog transcript sequences.

Only the **strict** external-catalog call (`known_catalog_hit`) feeds the novel figures in this
report; the per-source coverage columns are informative only and never filter. Strand is always
anchored to the candidate transcript.

## Tier and flags {.unnumbered}

```{r tier-flags, echo=FALSE}
tryCatch({
  # 4b.2: the catalog object is `catalog` (loaded above from params$gene_catalog);
  # an earlier version referenced a non-existent `gene_catalog` and silently
  # skipped this whole section.
  if (is.null(catalog) || nrow(catalog) == 0) {
    stop("gene catalog not loaded (params$gene_catalog missing or unreadable)")
  }
  cat_tbl <- catalog
  n <- nrow(cat_tbl)
  n_tier1 <- if ("tier_static" %in% colnames(cat_tbl)) sum(cat_tbl$tier_static %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
  cat(sprintf("Catalog genes: %d. Tier 1 (static): %s.\n", n,
              if (is.na(n_tier1)) "NA" else as.character(n_tier1)))
  flags <- intersect(c("single_exon_low_confidence", "antisense_status",
                       "x_host_leak_suspect"), colnames(cat_tbl))
  for (f in flags) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: %s\n", f,
                paste(names(table(cat_tbl[[f]], useNA = "ifany")),
                      table(cat_tbl[[f]], useNA = "ifany"), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat("\nTiers are labels, not filters: no gene is dropped by tier.\n")
}, error = function(e) cat(sprintf("*TIER SECTION SKIPPED: %s*\n", conditionMessage(e))))
```
